scope: Show Finder menus while the desktop has focus and open locations in the selected Dolphin or Nautilus file manager.
approval: The maintainer answered yes to the Finder menu preview showing both editions and both file managers.

checks.command: 11 isolated pytest checks passed for the native Global Menu and translation catalogs, including switching the default file manager in the same Finder menu.
KDE neon 6.8.1 Wayland: captured the Finder menu in Tahoe and Golden Gate in light and dark modes.
On KDE neon, selected Nautilus and Dolphin in turn. Each opened a separate Home window and handled Documents, Recents, Network and Trash. The focused app menu took over when its window opened.

coverage_limits: Rendered on KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1 Wayland. Native model, popup and composition tests used an isolated X11 session. Historical gallery captures retain their provenance.
